```{webr}
#| include: false
#| autorun: true

set.seed(1)
deliveries_dirty <- modeldata::deliveries %>%
    # 重复值: 复制 100 条记录
    bind_rows(modeldata::deliveries %>% slice_sample(n = 100)) %>%
    # 无效值: 将某些菜品数量设为NA
    mutate(item_01 = if_else(
        row_number() %in% sample(n(), 50),
        NA_integer_, item_01
    )) %>%
    # 错误值: 将 50 个 time_to_delivery 取反 (负的耗时无意义)
    mutate(time_to_delivery = if_else(
        row_number() %in% sample(n(), 50),
        -time_to_delivery, time_to_delivery
    )) %>%
    # 错误值: 将 30 个 hour 加 24 (超出 0--23 范围)
    mutate(hour = if_else(
        row_number() %in% sample(n(), 30),
        hour + 24L, hour
    ))
```

```{webr}
#| include: false
#| autorun: true

set.seed(2024)

ames_clean <- modeldata::ames %>%
    select(
        Lot_Area, Year_Built, Year_Sold, Gr_Liv_Area,
        Full_Bath, Bedroom_AbvGr, Sale_Price, Neighborhood) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 800)

ames_dirty <- ames_clean

# 1. 重复记录
ames_dirty <- bind_rows(ames_dirty, ames_clean[sample(800, 20), ])
m <- nrow(ames_dirty)

# 2. 无效值 NA
ames_dirty$Sale_Price[sample(m, 15)]  <- NA
ames_dirty$Gr_Liv_Area[sample(m, 10)] <- NA

# 3. 缺失哨兵值
ames_dirty$Lot_Area[sample(m, 12)] <- -1

# 4. 逻辑错误
e <- sample(m, 8)
ames_dirty$Year_Built[e] <- ames_dirty$Year_Sold[e] + sample(1:5, 8, replace = TRUE)

# 5. 取值越界
ames_dirty$Year_Sold[sample(m, 5)]  <- 2099
ames_dirty$Sale_Price[sample(m, 5)] <- 0

# 6. 类别文本不一致
ames_dirty$Neighborhood <- as.character(ames_dirty$Neighborhood)
u <- sample(m, 60); ames_dirty$Neighborhood[u] <- toupper(ames_dirty$Neighborhood[u])
s <- sample(m, 40); ames_dirty$Neighborhood[s] <- paste0("  ", ames_dirty$Neighborhood[s], " ")

# 7. 打乱行序
ames_dirty <- ames_dirty[sample(m), ]
```
